title: This Official ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Karaoke Machine Is Designed for Amateur Singers & (Soda) Pop Stars Alike
summary: The officially licensed release features a portable karaoke setup in the film's purple colorway, and finished with the HUNTR/X logo.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Another day, another KPop Demon Hunters collab , only this is one that hardcore fans and aspiring performers alike will want to pick up.

Netflix and eKids have released an official KPop Demon Hunters Karaoke Machine , available now for under $20 on Amazon . The portable karaoke machine comes in the film’s signature purple colorway, with the HUNTR/X logo on the speaker grill.

SING AT HOME

KPop Demon Hunters Bluetooth Karaoke Machine

$18.99 $20.99 10% off

Buy Now On Amazon

Save 10% off for a limited time when you apply the on-site coupon on Amazon.

The officially-licensed karaoke machine lets you sing your favorite songs from the Oscar-winning animated film (or any song, really) while enjoying an accompanying light show from the built-in, color-changing lights. Five different voice effects let you turn your sing-along into a real performance , whether you’re rehearsing for the Idol Awards or just sharing your “Strategy” at home.

This Amazon deal gets you a 9 x 3.7-inch speaker, a wireless microphone, built-in multi-colored LED lights and an included mini disco ball, that you can hang on the side of the speaker for every more lighting effects. Play your music by connecting the speaker to your phone, laptop or music player via Bluetooth (you can also plug in a flash drive).

Everything powers up via the built-in rechargeable battery, and a charging cable is included with the set. A handle on the speaker makes it easy to take your K-pop karaoke on the go.

LARGER SETUP

KPop Demon Hunters Bluetooth Karaoke Machine With Microphones

$59.98

Buy Now AT SAM'S CLUB

Want to take your soundtrack session up a notch? Sam’s Club sells this official KPop Demon Hunters karaoke machine which comes with a larger speaker and two wireless microphones (with the ability to plug in a third mic via a wired mic jack).

This karaoke system also lets you stream audio via Bluetooth and features seven light modes, including a “reactive” mode that pulses to the beat of your music. The two included mics have four built-in voice-changing effects, and you can also use the control pad at the top to adjust echo levels, volume, skip tracks and more.

Like the Amazon model, this Sam’s Club KPop Demon Hunters karaoke machine comes in a purple colorway with a glowing HUNTR/X logo front and center. And if you don’t have WiFi or Bluetooth, you can also connect your music via AUX, USB, and SD card inputs. Though it’s larger than the Amazon unit, this karaoke machine is still super portable, measuring approximately 7 x 10 inches in size.

Note: you don’t need to be a Sam’s Club member to score this KPop Demon Hunters karaoke setup, but non-members will be charged a 10% extra service fee online (consider it like a guest membership that lasts for 24 hours).

OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK

KPop Demon Hunters HUNTR/X Light Stick

Add to your karaoke night by picking up the official KPop Demon Hunters Light Stick . This HUNTR/X-themed device features five light-up colors and more than eight light sequences.

The official karaoke machines, meantime, come as the KPop Demon Hunters soundtrack continues to break records. The multi-platrinum album was the highest-debuting soundtrack of 2025 on the Billboard 200 chart, while lead single, “Golden,” topped Billboard’s Hot 100 chart and broke the record for longest leader on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart, earning a record-breaking 20th week at No. 1 on the latter chart in January.
